intent: A slim monochrome announcement strip above a site header: it unfolds on first view, rotating messages roll vertically, a badge shimmers once, and dismissing collapses the height so the page glides up.

stack.animation: motion/react (AnimatePresence, motion values, height auto, variants with custom delays)

layout.strip: section, overflow hidden, bg #0b0b0c, border-b white/8%; inner max-w 1280px is the @container
layout.desktop: grid 96px | 1fr | 96px, px 24px: pager | centred message | dismiss
layout.mobile: grid 1fr | auto, left-aligned message, pager hidden, whole row is the link
layout.message: badge, one-line text with ellipsis, link + arrow; `short` text under 896px
layout.options: optional dismissible (default true) and pager (default true) props; when off, an empty slot keeps the centre column aligned

color.approach: monochrome; the badge can take one optional accent prop, nothing else is coloured; tokens in one COLOR object
color.badge: ink #ffffff (or accent); fill = ink at 10% via color-mix; inset ring = ink at 22%
color.pager: 16×3px segments, track white/16%, fill white/90 (white/55 paused)

motion.roll: keyed AnimatePresence; enter y ±100% + blur 4px → 0, exit the other way; 500ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); direction-aware when jumping back
motion.shimmer: single sweep x -110% → 110%, 900ms ease-in-out, 350ms delay; never loops
motion.timer: useRotationTimer: rAF accumulates elapsed (5200ms default, steps capped at 100ms) into a motion value driving the active segment scaleX — no React render per frame; pauses on hover, focus, offscreen (IntersectionObserver), hidden tab
motion.dismiss: content fades 140ms, then height → 0 over 320ms cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)
motion.reducedMotion: no autoplay, 150ms opacity-only swaps and entrance, no shimmer, instant unfold and collapse
motion.entrance: first view: strip height 0 → auto 360ms; pager segment tracks draw (scaleX 0 → 1 from the left, 400ms) 40ms apart from 140ms; the first message rolls up from y 100% + blur 4px at 180ms; the badge shimmer follows 350ms later; dismiss lands last at 360ms (opacity, y 8px, blur 6px, 450ms); the rotation timer starts at 700ms so the first segment fills only after everything has landed. The strip mounts per showing, so bringing it back replays this.

responsive.1440: pager left, centred long message, link label
responsive.390: badge + short text + arrow, 44px dismiss, whole row tappable

accessibility: aria-live off while rotating, polite when paused
pager buttons labelled 'Announcement n of N' with aria-current
rotation pauses whenever focus is inside the strip

messages: New — Outpost 3.0 is here: incidents now draft their own postmortems. Read the release
Event — Incident Week, 14–16 November: four talks, zero slide decks. Save a seat
Beta — The Terraform provider now manages on-call rotas as code. View the docs
content.demo: the strip above a wordmark-only header row and the 3.0 release note it points to (eyebrow, headline, lead, three numbered hairline rows), all staggered in after the strip; a 'Bring the strip back' button after dismissal

avoid: brand gradient bars or marquee scrolling
removing the strip without animating its height
an orange or brand-tinted badge by default
skeleton bars or a fake nav as the demo stage
per-frame React state for the timer
